import pandas as pd

# List all source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/test_0.csv"
]

# Initialize an empty list to hold dataframes
dfs = []

# Load each source file, transform, and collect
for file_path in source_files:
    # Read the source CSV
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path)
    
    # Extract the V_GENE column by splitting J_CALL at '*'
    df['V_GENE'] = df['J_CALL'].str.split('*').str[0]
    
    # Select only the V_GENE column as per target schema
    df_target = df[['V_GENE']]
    
    dfs.append(df_target)

# Concatenate all transformed dataframes (if multiple sources)
result_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
result_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_55/target_multisource_cot.csv", index=False)
